title: Cohen–Macaulay prime localizations of finite flat algebras
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] such that $\operatorname{depth}(A_{\mathfrak p})=\dim A_{\mathfrak p}$ for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$, where prime localizations, depth, and Krull dimension are as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime; def-weil-pbc-depth; def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $B$ is Noetherian, and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset B$, writing $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, the ring $B_{\mathfrak q}$ is Noetherian local and satisfies $\operatorname{depth}(B_{\mathfrak q})=\dim B_{\mathfrak q}=\dim A_{\mathfrak p}$.

source.place: Tag 00R5 (lemma-finite-flat-over-regular-CM), second alternative after prime localization; global finite-flat form used in the proof of Tag 045M (lemma-tensor-fields-CM).

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-noetherian], $B$ is Noetherian. Fix a prime $\mathfrak q$ of $B$ and put $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, $R=A_{\mathfrak p}$ and $S=B_{\mathfrak q}$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-ring-maps]: $R,S$ are Noetherian local rings and the induced map $R\to S$ is flat and local.

By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral], $B$ is integral over $A$. Every strict chain $\mathfrak q_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak q_t\subseteq\mathfrak q$ contracts to a strict chain $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q_0)\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q_t)\subseteq\mathfrak p$ by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-incomparability]. The chain description [lem-weil-pbc-localization-dimension-chains-below-prime], applied to both primes, therefore gives $\dim S\leq\dim R$. This argument uses integrality of $A\to B$, without asserting finiteness or integrality of $R\to S$.

By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-finite-krull-dimension], write $\dim R=d$ with $d\in\mathbb N$. The hypothesis gives $\operatorname{depth}(R)=d$. By [def-weil-pbc-depth], there is a regular sequence $x_1,\ldots,x_d$ in the maximal ideal of $R$: a nonempty set of natural-number lengths with finite supremum $d$ contains $d$ (if $d>0$ and every length were smaller, $d-1$ would be an upper bound). For $d=0$, take the empty sequence; $R\neq0$ since it is a prime localization.

The flat local map $R\to S$ is faithfully flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat]. Apply [lem-sfb-regular-sequence-faithfully-flat-ascent] to the sequence just chosen. Its image is an $S$-regular sequence of length $d$, and its entries lie in the maximal ideal of $S$ by locality. Thus $d\leq\operatorname{depth}(S)$ by [def-weil-pbc-depth]. This includes the nonzero final quotient required for regularity, including when $d=0$.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-depth-le-support-dimension] to the nonzero finite $S$-module $S$. Its support is all of $\operatorname{Spec}S$: for every prime $P$, the fraction $1/1$ in $S_P$ cannot vanish, since that would require an element outside $P$ to equal zero. Consequently $\operatorname{depth}(S)\leq\dim S$. Combining the preceding bounds yields $d\leq\operatorname{depth}(S)\leq\dim S\leq\dim R=d$, proving both equalities. Since $\mathfrak q$ was arbitrary, this proves the assertion at every prime; if $B=0$, there are no primes and only the already proved Noetherianity assertion remains.

lean.statement: theorem finite_flat_algebra_local_depth_eq_dimension {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hCM : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], (IsLocalRing.depth (R := Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime p) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime p)) (φ : A →+* B) (hfinite : @Module.Finite A B _ _ φ.toAlgebra.toModule) (hflat : φ.Flat) : IsNoetherianRing B ∧ ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧ IsLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧ (IsLocalRing.depth (R := Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧ ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q) = ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap φ))
